maid_skill.eftlm_wom.guard.desc: Automatically block frontal attacks while holding a weapon.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.ender_step.desc: Automatically sidestep a nearby attack; costs 4 stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.ender_obscuris.desc: Sidestep, then teleport behind the target on a successful dodge; costs 7 stamina. Destination must be clear.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.shadow_step.desc: Automatically sidestep; a successful dodge adds 2 weapon energy. Costs 7 stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.precise_roll.desc: Automatically roll against a nearby attack; successful dodges refund 3 stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.dodge_master.desc: Automatically sidestep with an extended dodge window; successful dodges refund 4 stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.bull_charge.desc: Automatically shoulder-charge against nearby threats. Costs 8 stamina; 2-second cooldown.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.time_travel.desc: Record position and health when threatened. Recall after 3 seconds and heal 25% of lost health. Costs 12 stamina; 3-second cooldown after recall. Destination must be clear.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.punishment_kick.des: Automatically deliver a strong kick against nearby threats. Costs 8 stamina; 4-second cooldown.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.counter_attack.desc: Raise a weapon against nearby attacks and counter a blocked frontal hit. Costs 4 times the incoming damage in stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.vengeful_parry.desc: Automatically parry frontal attacks and retaliate with a strong punch. Costs 8 stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.perfect_bulwark.des: Automatically block frontal attacks for 20% of incoming damage in stamina; successful blocks refund the cost.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.soul_protection.des: Gain one charge every 0.6 seconds, up to 30. Taking damage spends 3 charges and reduces damage by 20% plus the remaining charge percentage.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.shulker_cloak.desc: Regenerate one shield charge every 3 seconds, up to 5. Spend a charge to reduce damage by 60%; damage restarts regeneration.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.buster_parade.desc: Automatically block frontal attacks and retaliate with a greatsword attack. Costs 50% of incoming damage in stamina.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.arrow_tenacity.desc: Remove Epic Fight stun and impact from incoming projectile damage.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.pain_anticipation.d: Briefly suppress impact and reduce damage by 40% after triggering. Latent Retribution extends the active window.
Taking damage briefly suppresses impact and grants 40% more damage. Pain Anticipation reduces its cooldown.
40% base critical chance plus 5% per armor Fire Protection level, capped at 100%. Critical damage is 2x plus 15% per Blast Protection level.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.heart_shield.desc: Regenerate absorption after 3 seconds without attacking or taking damage: 1 point every 1.5 seconds, up to 20. Protection enchantments accelerate recovery.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.mindset.desc: Above 70% health, deal 30% more damage and take 20% less damage.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.adrenaline.desc: Below 35% health, deal 60% more damage and take 40% less damage.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.dancing_blade.desc: Build rhythm on hits; every third hit deals 80% more damage. Hits on multiple targets in the same tick count once.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.meditation.desc: Automatically meditate while stationary with a weapon and no target; restart cooldown is 3 seconds. Progress through stages at 10, 20, 30 and 150 seconds, granting Strength, Haste, Resistance and Speed.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.inner_growth.desc: Add 0.05 energy per tick to learned skills for the held weapon, plus 0.0025 per armor Blast Protection level.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.dopamine.desc: Dash attacks restore twice the damage dealt as stamina; 2-second cooldown.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.manipulator.desc: Successful parries restore 60% of missing stamina. Requires a learned parry skill.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.lethal_focus.desc: Hits build damage bonuses by 6%, up to 80%. Fire Protection increases gain and Blast Protection increases the cap. Decays after 3 seconds without a hit.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.spider_techniques.d: Climb when colliding with a wall while pursuing a higher target; clear fall distance while climbing.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.aqua_maneuvre.desc: Automatically replenish air and gain Dolphin's Grace underwater.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.natural_sprinter.de: Gain 20% movement speed while pursuing a target more than 2 blocks away.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.lunatic_vivacity.de: Cycle in combat: adapted skills cost 15% stamina for 20 seconds, then 185% for 5 seconds.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.voodoo_magic.desc: Convert health to stamina when depleted. In combat, spend 0.5 health per second for 1.5 stamina; damage also restores some stamina. Retain at least 0.5 health.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.back_and_forth.desc: After a target retreats at least 12 blocks, automatically punch and slow it on returning within 3 blocks; 2-second cooldown.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.shooting_style.desc: Automatically use WOM three-kick combos while unarmed or holding a bow or fist weapon; 1-second cooldown between moves.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.proximity_exploiter: While enemies are within 10 blocks, gain 0.15 weapon energy per tick plus 0.05 per enemy.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.all_eyes_on_you.des: Defend against 3 distinct attacks to restore 0.4 stamina and 1 weapon energy per tick for 8 seconds. Requires dodge or parry skills.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.all_eyes_on_me.desc: Land 4 distinct attacks to restore 0.25 health, 0.3 stamina and 0.5 weapon energy per tick for 4 seconds.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.avatar_of_might.des: Charge while idle for 0.6 seconds, then taking damage triggers Avatar of Might for 12 stamina. Push back nearby enemies and gain 5 seconds of stun immunity; 4-second cooldown.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.charybdis.desc: Automatically perform a spinning attack with a WOM staff. Costs 6 stamina; 2-second cooldown.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.agony_plunge.desc: With Agony, charge from hits and automatically dive toward targets within 12 blocks. 100 energy per charge, up to 3.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.true_berserk.desc: With Tormented Mind, gain 200 energy from hits to enter 10 seconds of wrath, use berserk combos and deal 50% more damage.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.plunder_perdition.d: With Ruine, gain a charge per 16 energy from hits, up to 10; automatically alternate Ender Hands, Expiation and Redemption.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.sakura_state.desc: With Satsujin, gain a charge per 45 energy from hits, up to 12, and alternate forward and reverse Sakura slashes.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.ender_blast.desc: With a one-handed Ender Blaster, gain a charge per 6 energy, up to 12, and automatically cycle shooting and laser attacks.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.ender_fusion.desc: With a two-handed Ender Blaster, gain a charge per 12 energy, up to 24, and automatically cycle dual shooting and laser attacks.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.regierung.desc: With Herrscher, spend 10 stamina for 90 seconds of shield combos and 20% damage reduction.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.lunar_eclipse.desc: With Moonless, gain a charge per 160 energy, up to 2, and automatically unleash a lunar echo attack.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.solar_arcano.desc: With Solar, gain 100 energy to automatically cast Solar Arcano and ignite the target for 6 seconds.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.rechargement.desc: With Napoleon, spend 8 stamina to reload. Refill 3 shots with Napoleon Passive and gain 20% damage for 10 seconds.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.orbital_beam.desc: With Orbit, gain a charge per 64 energy, up to 4, and summon a WOM orbital beam on a visible target within 32 blocks.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.flash_mutilation.de: With Nova, gain a charge per 48 energy, up to 4, teleport behind the target if clear and perform Flash Mutilation.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.unbreakable.desc: With Blackstar, gain 82 energy for 3 defensive charges lasting 10 seconds. Each hit spends a charge for 30% damage reduction and no impact.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.satsujin_passive.de: Charge learned Satsujin skills while holding Satsujin and not attacking: 0.5 energy per tick without a target, or 0.15 in combat.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.ruine_passive.desc: Ruine hits restore 0.15 stamina per tick for 7 seconds.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.herrscher_passive.d: Herrscher hits build 2 defensive charges, up to 50. Each charge reduces damage by 1%; damage spends 5 charges.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.torment_passive.des: Charge 2 stacks per idle combat tick while holding Tormented Mind. At 20 stacks, the next hit deals triple damage and spends the charge.
While holding Moonless and not attacking, charge learned Moonless skills by 0.2 energy per tick.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.solar_passive.desc: Build 2 heat per combat tick with Solar; hits ignite targets above 20 heat. Cool down when no target remains.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.napoleon_passive.de: Automatically fire Napoleon while ammunition is available; 0.6-second shot cooldown. Rechargement replenishes ammunition.
Evil Tachi hits on Withered targets heal 1 health. Hits have a 40% base chance to apply stacking Wither, plus 10% per Sweeping Edge level, capped at 100%.
maid_skill.eftlm_wom.unbreakable_passive: Blackstar hits grant Epic Fight stun immunity for 2 seconds.
